Nave de 298 m2 disponible para almacén/garaje, es diáfano y está situado en la planta baja del edificio, con acceso directo desde calle con puerta de garaje. Muy buena oportunidad. Para actualizar. inv.desc_en: REDPISO ZONA CARABANCHEL OPORTO sells a local-warehouse very close to Camino Viejo de Leganes. Warehouse of 298 m2 available for storage/garage, it is diaphanous and is located on the ground floor of the building, with direct access from the street with a garage door. Very good opportunity. To update. Check with our advisors for your financing. Carabanchel is one of the 21 districts that make up the city of Madrid. It is administratively divided into the neighborhoods of Comillas, Opañel, San Isidro, Vista Alegre, Puerta Bonita, Buenavista and Abrantes. It is located in the southern sector of the city, between the M-30, M-40, A-42 motorways and the Vía Carpetana. It is bordered to the north by the Manzanares River and the Arganzuela district; to the south, with the town of Leganés; to the east, with the Usera district; and to the west, with the Latina district. EXPENSES OF WRITING AND TAXES NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE.
